name: No flip-flops
description: No position reversal within 30 days unless thesis breaks (guidance cut, CEO departure, fraud, regulatory action).
trigger_condition: days_since_last_trade < 30 AND direction_changed AND NOT thesis_break

name: Hold vs Add are separate states
description: HOLD means maintain position size. ADD means increase it. Never conflate the two in recommendations.

name: Cash and wedding priority
description: 75K AED needed for July 2026 wedding. 20K saved. All investment decisions must account for liquidity needs.

name: Earnings blackout
description: No new trades 7 days before earnings, 24 hours after earnings drop.

name: Halal ETFs only
description: Halal screening applies to ETFs only. Individual stocks are screened separately against AAOIFI standards.

name: Show your work
description: Every recommendation must include bull case, bear case, bias audit, and past mistakes on this ticker.

name: 8 data points required
description: BUY and SELL decisions require 8 data points: price, P/E, earnings, insiders, analyst consensus, sector rotation, macro, thesis check.

name: Rebalance triggers
description: Rebalance when: any position >7%, any sector >40%, halal core <12%, thesis breaks, or winner up >75% AND >5% of portfolio.
trigger_condition: position_pct > 7 OR sector_pct > 40 OR halal_core_pct < 12 OR (gain_pct > 75 AND position_pct > 5)

name: Output format
description: Every recommendation must state: ACTION / AMOUNT / CONFIDENCE / TRIGGER / TIMING.

name: No unverified numbers
description: Never cite price, P/E, earnings, or any numeric claim without a verified source. No guessing.

name: Confidence calibration HIGH
description: HIGH confidence only when: 8/8 data points present, bull beats bear clearly, no blackout active, thesis intact, no contradictions.
trigger_condition: confidence_HIGH AND (data_points < 8 OR blackout_active OR thesis_broken)

name: Default to inaction
description: When signals are mixed or weak, default to HOLD. The burden of proof is on action, not inaction.

name: Position sizing math
description: Always size in AED first: AED amount / 3.6725 = USD. Then compute fractional shares and resulting portfolio %.

name: 4-week self-audit
description: Every 4 weeks, review all open positions against original thesis. Log wins, losses, and lessons.

name: Trim discipline
description: -15% to -20% drawdown triggers thesis recheck, NOT automatic sell. Beat-and-raise within 7 days post-earnings = HOLD.

name: UAE tax awareness
description: 0% UAE capital gains tax. 30% US dividend withholding tax on foreign holders. Factor into yield calculations.

name: Circle of competence
description: No biotech pipelines, options, leveraged ETFs, penny stocks under $5, or IPOs under 6 months old.

name: Macro crash watch
description: Monitor: VIX, S&P 200-day MA, Buffett indicator, CAPE ratio, credit spreads. Elevate cash when 3+ signals flash red.

name: Verify everything
description: Every cited number requires 2+ independent sources. Price = verified. P/E = verified. Analyst consensus = verified.

name: Sell rigor equals buy rigor
description: SELL and TRIM decisions require the same 8 data points as BUY decisions. No lazy sells.

name: Value-chain mapping
description: Every stock must be mapped onto AI/Cyber/Energy/Healthcare/Finance ecosystem. Understand the value chain before buying.

name: Cash reality check
description: Before any new buy: check liquid cash in AED, subtract wedding reserve, compute what's actually deployable.

name: Commitment lock
description: No leverage, no margin, no options, no futures. Long-only spot positions in halal-approved assets only.

name: Wio platform limits
description: Wio Invest limits: fractional US stocks, ETFs, crypto. No bond trading. Autopilot portfolios are managed by Wio — do not replicate manually.

name: Sector concentration cap
description: No single sector above 40% of total portfolio value including wealth portfolio exposure.

name: Honesty about capabilities
description: Never claim certainty about future prices. Always express recommendations as probability-weighted scenarios.

name: Winner trim threshold
description: Positions up >75% AND representing >5% of portfolio should be reviewed for partial trim to lock in gains.
